besluite.fout: The pair 'nie net met woorde nie maar ook deur kuns' switches preposition halfway, so the contrast reads unbalanced.
besluite.rede: Both prepositions mean 'by means of' here, so the meaning stays the same and the parallel 'met ... met' reads more cleanly.

besluite.fout: 'op rotse rotskuns' puts two near-identical words side by side and makes a reader stumble.
besluite.rede: Fronting the object is natural Afrikaans, removes the stumble, keeps the protected word 'rotskuns' unchanged and ends on the new term.

besluite.fout: Sentence-initial 'So' copies English 'So,' and can be read as 'in this way' rather than as the consequence it is.
besluite.rede: 'Daarom' states the same cause and effect (we cannot ask the painters, therefore experts read carefully) without ambiguity.

besluite.fout: Causal 'oor' after 'geword' is loose spoken usage and can be misread as 'about'.
besluite.rede: 'vanweë' gives the same reason plainly, and no protected name or wording is touched.

besluite.fout: The separable 'sluit ... in' is split by the object, leaving 'in van hoe om' as an awkward run that reads woodenly.
besluite.rede: 'Deel van dié kultuur is hul kennis' says the same thing, keeps the same referent for 'hul', and flows into 'Daarby hoort ...'.

besluite.fout: 'saam erfenis vorm' reads slightly stiff, though 'erfenis' as a mass noun is not strictly ungrammatical.
besluite.rede: This rewords a glossary definition beyond a plain grammar error and slightly shifts 'heritage' towards 'a heritage', so only the writer may change it, for every lesson at once.
